court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Srinivas Krishna Katageri vs Niharika Srinivas Katageri
facts_of_case: Parties to the Civil Revision Application seek withdrawal of Application-Exhibit-8 with liberty to take out fresh proceedings for waiver of notice period contemplated under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act in the matter of divorce by mutual consent.

legal_principles.principle: Parties to a Civil Revision Application are at liberty to take out fresh proceedings for waiver of notice period contemplated under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act in the matter of divorce by mutual consent.
legal_principles.held: Once such application is tendered, this Court expects the parties to depict appropriate details.

outcome.final_order: Parties are at liberty to take out fresh proceedings for waiver of notice period contemplated under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

use_for_drafting: preparing joint application for waiver of notice period
